response.text: {"verdict": "covered", "clause_ids": ["A4.1"], "rationale": "The claim involves medication (nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs) prescribed as part of treatment for an acute injury (ankle sprain) that occurred during the trip. Clause A4.1 covers the cost of medication prescribed by a doctor for an acute illness or injury during the trip. There is no indication that the injury was pre-existing, planned, or related to alcohol, war, terrorism, or extreme sports (clause A11.3 does not apply because the policy includes extreme sports and the injury is not related to such activity)."}
